summary: Alvotech filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing that the FDA closed its inspection of the company's manufacturing facility in Reykjavik, Iceland, confirming a Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI) classification. The filing does not involve a merger, acquisition, tender offer, activist campaign, spin-off, restructuring, or any other special situation. It is a routine regulatory update on FDA inspection status and biosimilar pipeline progress. No transaction terms, board recommendations, advisors, or deal mechanics are discussed. This event is purely operational and regulatory, not a corporate finance or control event.
